description: ACIS Climate Maps is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by High Plains Regional Climate Center; Applied Climate Information System. Access clearly labeled, color-coded maps showing temperature and precipitation measurements from weather and climate stations across the United States. Drop-down menus give instant access to maps that let you explore how recent temperature and precipitation patterns compare to past conditions. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
